When is it worth starting?

You have solar PV, battery storage or several metering points, but energy decisions are still made manually. Optimisation requires usable data, technical access and tariffs that make the scenario economically viable. A conventional office with one meter and no controllable assets may only need a simpler solution.

Generated illustration
LESS UNCERTAINTY

Technical and commercial terms are defined after analysing your specific site.

Our aim is to use your existing infrastructure. Access to readings and commands depends on the specific models, firmware and interfaces. We check this before agreeing on the integration; an additional gateway or metering equipment may sometimes be needed.

Yes. Metering and control are separate modules. You can start by gaining visibility into consumption and generation, then add optimisation after collecting data and checking the economics.

Export depends on the technical conditions, connection arrangement, contracts and regulatory requirements. We assess self-consumption and export capability separately during the site analysis.

The minimum state of charge and backup priority are set as separate constraints. These are agreed before launch so the economic scenario does not consume the reserve your business needs.

The safe operating scenario for a communication failure is defined during design, taking local automation and inverter capabilities into account. It must be verified on site before switching to automatic mode.

Cost depends on the modules, number of metering points, available interfaces and control complexity. After the initial analysis, we prepare a proposal specifying the integration scope and platform usage terms.

Every site has its own conditions.Ask us directly ↗
